models.intro: The short framing block at the top of the page — a headline and one-line subhead that set up the suggestions.
models.suggestion: A single inspirational behavior card. Has a title, a short or longer description, and an icon name (lucide-react) shown at the top of the card. No completion or submission state — purely informational.

relationships: The page has one intro and a list of suggestion records displayed in order.
Suggestions are independent of each other — there is no state shared between them.

intro.headline: Small acts. Lived square.
intro.subhead: Three quiet ways to keep the Lederhof living and clean. Pick one that fits how you already move through the square.

suggestions.title: Carry it to the bin
suggestions.description: Hold on to your butt, your wrapper, your cup until you reach a bin. It's usually less than thirty seconds of walking — and it's the single behavior that moves the numbers most.

suggestions.title: Pick up one piece
suggestions.description: Each time you cross the square, pick up one piece of litter that isn't yours and bin it. One person, one piece, every visit. The math is unreasonably good: at the Lederhof's daily foot traffic, this single habit removes more litter than the city's nightly cleaning crew.

suggestions.title: Mention it once
suggestions.description: Tell one friend that the Lederhof is being looked after now. Identity follows attention — the more people who see the square as cared-for, the fewer who treat it as already lost.
